data.name: Asheeq
data.gender_notes: Asheeq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted, a lover, an admirer. A worshiper. A person who is devoted to a cause or to someone. One who loves horses. The name Asheeq carries the meaning “Lover, Worshiper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asheeq usually hope their child will grow to embody lover, worshiper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A deep sense of love and devotion towards the divine. A person who is in love with Allah and strives to please Him.
data.etymology: Asheeq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover, Worshiper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asheeq total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
